golden_vector_script:
import pathlib,struct,json,hashlib
p=pathlib.Path('vectors');p.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
base=pathlib.Path('/srv/opentallas-scratch/codex/q-static-pv-1014')
a=(base/'actual-tree-p0-steady-8192.bin').read_bytes();b=(base/'actual-tree-p1-steady-8192.bin').read_bytes()
(p/'pair0.bin').write_bytes(a);(p/'pair1.bin').write_bytes(b)
f=lambda z:struct.unpack('<f',struct.pack('<f',z))[0]
rz=[2.0**-13]*4
(p/'reciprocal.bin').write_bytes(struct.pack('<4f',*rz))
x=struct.unpack('<512f',a);y=struct.unpack('<512f',b)
gold=[f(f(u+v)*rz[i//128]) for i,(u,v) in enumerate(zip(x,y))]
(p/'gold.bin').write_bytes(struct.pack('<512f',*gold))
(p/'receipt.json').write_text(json.dumps({'scope':'STATIC_JOIN_COMPONENT_DECLARED_PAIR_AND_RECIPROCAL_INPUTS_ONLY','pair_inputs':'actual source-pinned real-RTL staticPV pair outputs','reciprocal':'declared dyadic 2^-13 component input, not integrated Z proof','files':{q.name:hashlib.sha256(q.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for q in p.glob('*.bin')}},indent=2)+'\n')
